name: claude-usage-monitor
description: Monitor your Claude Code usage limits in the status bar with smart model and effort recommendations

claudeUsage.autoFetch.description: Automatically fetch usage data from Claude API on startup and at regular intervals

claudeUsage.refreshInterval.description: How often (in minutes) to fetch usage data from the API

claudeUsage.showInStatusBar.description: Show Claude usage in the status bar

claudeUsage.compactStatusBar.description: Use a compact status-bar label: '<icon> X% (current) Y% (week)' instead of '<icon> Claude Usage: X% (current) Y% (week)'.

claudeUsage.thresholds.moderate.description: Usage percentage at which the Moderate urgency level is triggered

claudeUsage.thresholds.high.description: Usage percentage at which the High urgency level is triggered

claudeUsage.thresholds.critical.description: Usage percentage at which the Critical urgency level is triggered

claudeUsage.notificationTimeoutSeconds.description: How long (in seconds) Claude Usage notifications stay on screen before auto-dismissing. Set this so notifications never stack while VS Code is in the background. Manual dismiss via the X button is always available.

claudeUsage.colors.moderate.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Moderate level. Use a hex color (e.g. #cca700) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

claudeUsage.colors.high.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the High level. Use a hex color (e.g. #f0643c) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

claudeUsage.colors.critical.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Critical level. Use a hex color (e.g. #e05555) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

enumDescriptions: Automatically evaluate thresholds against whichever metric is currently highest
Evaluate thresholds against the Current Session usage
Evaluate thresholds against the Weekly usage
claudeUsage.thresholdMetric.description: Which usage metric the urgency thresholds and notifications are evaluated against
